title: With two browser tabs open, the last display change wins
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. The same user signed in in two browser tabs on Work Orders.
custom_steps:
1. In tab A set Tech View.
  2. In tab B set Board View a moment later.
  3. Reload both tabs.
  4. Observe the display each opens in.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If you change the preference in two tabs at once, the last request is the one that sticks.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10044 — Story 1 Switch between display options. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S1-N5 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-N5: “For the same user in simultaneous tabs, the last preference request wins.”
